notes:
Status: closed-lost to Replicate (primary) with Fireworks used for infra proof-of-concept. High-level: Veridian ran a 3-week POC (Dec 01 - Dec 21) focused on reranking and real-time recommendations. POC goals: p50 latency <50ms on 512-token rerank path, sustain 200 RPS with cold-cache, per-query cost target equivalent to $0.0005/token. What happened:
- 2025-11-18: Intro call (Luis) — very engaged CTO (A. Kim). Interested in Dedicated + VPC deployment. Emphasis on data residency and KMS integration.
- 2025-11-25: SE scoping (Priya) — ran perf baseline, initial kernel choices looked good; flagged KMS/HSM integration as dependency.
- 2025-12-01: Kickoff + Fireflies ff_2025-12-03_v1 (transcript). Notes: "If we can't lock keys to our HSM, security won't sign off."
- 2025-12-15: Mid-POC sync — Redwood demoed autoscaling and batching gains; internal infra team ran side-by-side throughput tests vs Replicate. Replicate cheaper in this topology due to existing infra credits and custom Docker-based workflow.
- 2025-12-22: Security review (legal) — raised issue: Redwood control plane cross-region metadata; asked for explicit audit log export path and contractual data residency SLA. Provided security FAQ (drive link) but Veridian wanted on-prem-compatible key rotation policy and signed ISO attestation.
- 2026-01-09: Budget freeze announced (finance) — Veridian prioritizes contract renewals and consolidates vendor spend. CTO: "we need lowest friction to prod."
- 2026-01-18: Final decision call — Veridian selected Replicate + Fireworks for infra orchestration. Primary reasons cited: existing infra credits, faster on-prem container workflow, and Replicate's prebuilt ops that matched their MLOps pipelines. Redwood was competitive on latency but lagged on KMS/HSM contractual details and immediate TCO.
- 2026-01-22: Closed-lost logged in CRM (Luis).
Why lost (summary): mixed reasons — procurement/budget freeze + lack of an internal champion after hiring pause, plus specific security/KMS contractual gap that slowed legal approval. Replicate offered lower near-term TCO with easier MLOps integration; Fireworks used for private infra glue.
Notes / follow-ups: short-term: archive POC artifacts, close tickets. Medium-term: re-open after Q3 budget cycle, propose staged KMS pilot and a small on-prem test cluster to address legal concerns.
